Credits & licences

Al-Murāja’ah is a Qur’an revision app by S. Adnan. This is its download and showcase website.

Website assets

Calligraphy, wordmarks, app icons and screenshots are the approved Al-Murāja’ah project assets. Their inclusion here does not grant general permission to redistribute the artwork. Screenshots show the released 1.0.1+36 Android app with demonstration data; they have been resized and encoded as WebP for this site.

The Cairo font is bundled unmodified under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, including copyright notices. No font service is contacted. The sharing image combines project artwork with original website typography and decoration. The small platform controls use original outline illustrations and are not official store download badges.

App content

The app credits Goni Bukar Zarami and the replacement recordings of Shaykh Umar Idris and Shaykh Yahaya Ibrahim Muhammad. Chapter names and transliterations are based on Tanzil Quran Metadata v1.0 (upstream identifies cc-by without a version), with project extraction changes. No recitation audio is hosted on this website.

For recording, asset and dependency details, read the app’s third-party notices and catalogue attribution. Public delivery URLs do not confer recording redistribution rights.
